"""Bind report tables to fixed final scores, without inference or endpoint selection."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1')
scores = json.loads((root / 'scores-v1.json').read_text())
methods = ['parent'] + [f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000' for arm in ['paired-control', 'harmonic-context'] for endpoint in ['raw', 'EMA']]
labels = dict(zip(methods, ['V143', 'Pair ctrl raw', 'Pair ctrl EMA', 'Harmonic raw', 'Harmonic EMA'], strict=True))
cells, lines = [], []
sections = {}

def group(kind, condition, cohort=None):
    return {s['method']: s for s in scores['summary']
            if (s['kind'], s['condition'], s['cohort']) == (kind, condition, cohort)}

def val(g, method, field, digits=6):
    item = g[method]
    text = f'{item[field]:.{digits}f}'
    cells.append({k: item[k] for k in ['kind', 'condition', 'cohort', 'method']} |
                 {'field': field, 'digits': digits, 'rendered': text})
    return text

def row(title, g, field, digits=6):
    line = '|' + title + '|' + '|'.join(val(g, method, field, digits) for method in methods) + '|'
    lines.append(line)
    return line + '\n'

def header(title):
    return '|' + title + '|' + '|'.join(labels[m] for m in methods) + '|\n| --- |' + ' ---: |' * len(methods) + '\n'

text = '| Method | Present full RMS | Response | Actual blank RMS | Blank spatial RMS | Added blank RMS |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
for method in methods + ['periodic-detail']:

        val(group('mesh', True), method, field, digits) for field, digits in [

            ('blank_spatial_RMS_DN16', 6), ('blank_added_RMS_DN16', 8)]) + '|'
    lines.append(line)

sections['mesh'] = text

                 ('Native512 ISO12800', group('flat', 'iso12800-prior', 'fresh-flat512')),

    for suffix, field in [(' full RMS', 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), (' spatial RMS', 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16'), (' block32 RMS', 'block32_RMS_DN16')]:
        text += row(title + suffix, g, field)
sections['flat'] = text
text = header('Photo test')
for title, condition, cohort in [('Retained512 faint', 'photo-faint', 'retained512'), ('Retained512 dark', 'photo-dark', 'retained512'), ('Organic384 faint', 'photo-faint', 'organic384'), ('Organic384 dark', 'photo-dark', 'organic384')]:
    for suffix, field in [(' full RMS', 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), (' band error', 'crop_relative_band_error'), (' band response', 'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain')]:
        text += row(title + suffix, group('photo', condition, cohort), field)
sections['photo'] = text
text = '| Prior | Method | Whole RMS | Quiet RMS | Quiet spatial RMS |\n| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
for condition, title in [('iso6400-prior', 'ISO6400'), ('iso12800-prior', 'ISO12800')]:
    g = group('mixed-quiet', condition)
    for method in methods:
        line = '|' + title + '|' + labels[method] + '|' + '|'.join(val(g, method, field) for field in ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16']) + '|'
        lines.append(line)
        text += line + '\n'
sections['quiet'] = text
text = header('ADC test')
adc, slopes = group('photo', 'adc-only', 'adc-photo256'), group('flat', 'adc-only', 'adc-sloped512')
for title, g, field in [('Photo full RMS', adc, 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), ('Photo band error', adc, 'crop_relative_band_error'), ('Photo band response', adc, 'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'), ('Sloped512 full RMS', slopes, 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 spatial RMS', slopes, 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 block32 RMS', slopes, 'block32_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 crop block32 RMS', slopes, 'crop_block32_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 worst absolute DC', slopes, 'worst_abs_DC_DN16')]:
    text += row(title, g, field)
sections['ADC'] = text
assert len(cells) == 205
(root / 'report-table-bindings-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cells': cells, 'lines': lines, 'sections': sections}, indent=2) + '\n')

"""Separate quiet-region bias from spatial error using original RGB pixels."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1'
scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json')
cases={c['id']:c for c in read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations'] if c['kind']=='mixed-quiet'}
assert len(cases)==32
methods=['parent','paired-control-raw-step1000','paired-control-EMA-step1000','harmonic-context-raw-step1000','harmonic-context-EMA-step1000']
records=[];maximum=0.
for row in scores['rows']:
    if row['id'] not in cases:continue
    c=cases[row['id']];x,y,w,h=c['ROI_xywh']
    assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction'] and ref(c['arrays']['path'])==c['arrays']
    target=np.load(c['arrays']['path'])['target'][0,:,y:y+h,x:x+w].astype(np.float64)
    value=np.load(row['prediction']['path'])[0,:,y:y+h,x:x+w].astype(np.float64)
    error=(value-target)*65535
    bias=np.array([sum(channel.ravel())/(w*h) for channel in error])
    dc=float(np.linalg.norm(bias)/np.sqrt(3))
    spatial=float(np.linalg.norm(error-bias[:,None,None])/np.sqrt(error.size))
    total=float(np.linalg.norm(error)/np.sqrt(error.size))
    for actual,field in [(dc,'crop_DC_RMS_DN16'),(spatial,'quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),(total,'quiet_error_RMS_DN16')]:
        difference=abs(actual-row[field]);maximum=max(maximum,difference);assert difference<1e-9,(c['id'],field,difference)
    assert abs(total**2-spatial**2-dc**2)<1e-9
    records.append({'id':c['id'],'method':row['method'],'prior':c['noise']['name'],'template':c['template'],
                    'bias_RGB_DN16':bias.tolist(),'DC_RMS_DN16':dc,'spatial_RMS_DN16':spatial,'total_RMS_DN16':total})
assert len(records)==160
groups=[]
for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']:
    for method in methods:
        selected=[r for r in records if r['prior']==prior and r['method']==method]
        assert len(selected)==16
        groups.append({'prior':prior,'method':method,'cases':16,
            **{f'mean_{field}':float(np.mean([r[field] for r in selected])) for field in ['DC_RMS_DN16','spatial_RMS_DN16','total_RMS_DN16']}})
output=root/'quiet-DC-audit-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass-independent-original-pixel-quiet-DC-decomposition','scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'rows':records,'groups':groups,
    'scalar_checks':480,'per_case_energy_identities':160,'maximum_scalar_difference':maximum,
    'new_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Native exact quiet ROIs,160 method/case outputs. Bias averaged per camera-RGB channel before Euclidean RMS. Total squared=spatial squared+DC squared verified per case;group mean RMS values do not obey that identity. Mean DC identifies observed bias cost,not an isolated cause such as global context or path gradients.'})
import shutil
public=repo/'docs/results/v161-harmonic-context-quiet-DC-audit-v1.json';assert not public.exists()

import hashlib
import json
import os
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def ref(path):
    p = Path(path).resolve()
    return {"path": str(p), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


def linear(v, arrays):
    return np.einsum("bij,bjhw->bihw", arrays["matrix"].astype(np.float64), v.astype(np.float64)*arrays["wb"].astype(np.float64)[..., None, None])


def band(v, arrays):
    basis = np.cos(np.pi*(np.arange(16)[None]+.5)*np.arange(16)[:, None]/16)*np.sqrt(2/16)
    basis[0] /= np.sqrt(2)
    luma = np.einsum("c,bchw->bhw", np.array([.2126, .7152, .0722]), linear(v, arrays))
    blocks = luma.reshape(1, 10, 16, 10, 16).transpose(0, 1, 3, 2, 4).reshape(1, 100, 16, 16)
    frequency = np.arange(16)/32
    r = np.hypot(frequency[:, None], frequency[None])
    return (basis @ blocks @ basis.T)[..., (r >= 1/8) & (r < 1/3)]


def photo_metrics(value, target, arrays, roi):
    result = errors(value, target, roi)
    x, y, w, h = roi
    a, b = [v[..., y:y+h, x:x+w].astype(np.float64) for v in (value, target)]
    result["crop_error_RMS_DN16"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((a-b)**2))*65535)
    p, t = band(a, arrays), band(b, arrays)
    energy = float(np.sum(t*t))
    gain = float(np.sum(p*t)/energy)
    result.update(crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain=gain, crop_relative_band_error=float(np.sqrt(np.sum((p-t)**2)/energy)), crop_orthogonal_band_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.sum((p-gain*t)**2)/25600)*65535))
    return result


def errors(value, target, roi):
    x, y, w, h = roi
    error = value.astype(np.float64)-target.astype(np.float64)
    crop = error[..., y:y+h, x:x+w]
    dc = crop.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
    return {"full_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2))*65535), "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((crop-dc)**2))*65535), "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2))*65535)}


def detrend(value):
    # Closed affine moments on the symmetric regular grid, independent of QR.
    y, x = np.mgrid[-1:1:512j, -1:1:512j]
    value = value.astype(np.float64)
    centered = value-value.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)
    bx = np.sum(centered*x, (-2, -1), keepdims=True)/np.sum(x*x)
    by = np.sum(centered*y, (-2, -1), keepdims=True)/np.sum(y*y)
    return centered-bx*x-by*y


def main():
    os.nice(10)
    cores = sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
    if len(cores) >= 4:
        os.sched_setaffinity(0, cores[2:4])
    plan_path = ROOT / "transfer-plan-v1.json"

    assert result["RNG_unchanged"] and result["RNG_before"] == result["RNG_after"]
    rows = defaultdict(list)
    for row in result["rows"]:
        rows[row["id"]].append(row)
    assert len(rows) == len(plan["observations"]) == 694
    scalar_count, max_difference, real_rows, flat_identity, absent_identity = 0, 0., 0, 0, 0
    for index, case in enumerate(plan["observations"]):
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        assert ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        parent = np.load(case["parent"]["path"])
        for row in rows[case["id"]]:
            assert row["index"] == index and row["kind"] == case["kind"]
            assert ref(row["prediction"]["path"]) == row["prediction"]
            value = np.load(row["prediction"]["path"])
            assert value.shape == parent.shape and np.isfinite(value).all()
            assert row["changed"] == (not np.array_equal(value, parent))
            if row["method"] == "collaborative":
                if case["kind"] == "flat" and np.array_equal(value, parent):
                    flat_identity += 1
                if case["kind"] == "mesh" and not case["present"] and np.array_equal(value, parent):
                    absent_identity += 1
            if case["kind"] == "real":
                assert row["reference_scored"] is False
                assert not any(k in row for k in ("template_gain", "full_error_RMS_DN16"))
                real_rows += 1

            if case["kind"] == "photo":

            else:

            if case["kind"] == "mesh":

                blank = np.all(arrays["target_present"] == arrays["target_empty"], axis=1)[0] if case["present"] else np.ones((512, 512), bool)
                actual["template_gain"] = projection

                else:

    aggregation_difference = 0.

def photo_metrics(value, target, arrays, roi):
    from report_checkpoint_pilot import band

    from demosaic.archive_metrics import linear_rgb

    x, y, w, h = roi
    a, b = [v[..., y : y + h, x : x + w].astype(np.float64) for v in (value, target)]
    error = a - b
    dc = error.mean((-1, -2), keepdims=True)
    predicted, _ = band(linear_rgb(a, arrays))
    truth, _ = band(linear_rgb(b, arrays))
    energy = float(np.sum(truth * truth))
    if energy <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Photo diagnostic needs nonzero target detail")
    gain = float(np.sum(predicted * truth) / energy)
    return {
        "full_error_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.mean((value.astype(np.float64) - target) ** 2)) * 65535
        ),
        "crop_error_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_DC_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(dc**2)) * 65535),
        "crop_spatial_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((error - dc) ** 2)) * 65535),
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain": gain,
        "crop_relative_band_error": float(np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - truth) ** 2) / energy)),
        "crop_orthogonal_band_RMS_DN16": float(
            np.sqrt(np.sum((predicted - gain * truth) ** 2) / (100 * 256)) * 65535
        ),
    }


def report(path):
    from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels

    from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar

    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    root = Path(plan["root"])
    parent = {
        o["id"]: o["parent_prediction"] for o in plan["observations"] if "parent_prediction" in o
    }
    predictions, checkpoints = {}, {}
    for label, count in (("V143", 64), ("V144", 128), ("V145", 128)):
        point = root / label
        actual = read(point / "plan-v1.json")
        guard(actual)
        collection = read(point / "collection-v1.json")
        assert collection["plan"] == ref(point / "plan-v1.json")
        assert collection["counts"] == {"root": count, "encoder": count}
        assert collection["RNG_unchanged"]
        assert collection["full_model_before"] == collection["full_model_after"]
        assert collection["backbone_before"] == collection["backbone_after"]
        bindings = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in collection["observations"]}
        if label == "V143":
            assert not parent.keys() & bindings.keys()
            parent.update(bindings)
            bindings = parent
        predictions[label] = bindings
        checkpoints[label] = actual["checkpoint"]
    assert all(set(p) == {o["id"] for o in plan["observations"]} for p in predictions.values())
    out = root / "report-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    rows, images = [], []
    for observation in plan["observations"]:
        assert ref(observation["arrays"]["path"]) == observation["arrays"]
        with np.load(observation["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as data:
            arrays = {k: data[k] for k in data.files}
        values = {}
        for label, bindings in predictions.items():
            binding = bindings[observation["id"]]
            assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
            values[label] = np.load(binding["path"], allow_pickle=False)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "id": observation["id"],
                    "source_id": observation["source"]["id"],
                    "cohort": observation["cohort"],
                    "variant": observation["variant"]["name"],
                    "pattern": observation["pattern"],
                    "method": label,
                    "prediction": binding,
                    **photo_metrics(
                        values[label], arrays["target"], arrays, observation["ROI_xywh"]
                    ),
                }
            )
        if observation["pattern"] != "RGGB":
            continue
        all_values = {"Noisy": noisy_malvar(arrays), **values, "Constructed GT": arrays["target"]}
        roi = observation["ROI_xywh"]
        x, y, w, h = roi
        anchor = (
            arrays["target"][..., y : y + h, x : x + w]
            .astype(np.float64)
            .mean((-1, -2), keepdims=True)
        )

        def emit(
            labels,
            contrast,
            suffix,
            observation=observation,
            all_values=all_values,
            anchor=anchor,
            arrays=arrays,
            roi=roi,
        ):
            canvas = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(labels), 192), "#eeeeee")
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
            panels = []
            for i, label in enumerate(labels):
                value = anchor + contrast * (all_values[label].astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                cell = pixels(value, arrays, roi, observation["display_exposure"])
                assert cell.shape == (160, 160, 3)
                x0 = 8 + 168 * i
                canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), (x0, 24))
                draw.text((x0, 5), label, font=font, fill="black")
                panels.append({"label": label, "xywh": [x0, 24, 160, 160]})
            target = out / (observation["id"] + "-" + suffix + ".png")
            canvas.save(target)
            reread = np.asarray(Image.open(target))
            for panel in panels:
                label = panel["label"]
                value = anchor + contrast * (all_values[label].astype(np.float64) - anchor)
                cell = pixels(value, arrays, roi, observation["display_exposure"])
                x0, y0, w0, h0 = panel["xywh"]
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(reread[y0 : y0 + h0, x0 : x0 + w0], cell)
            images.append(
                {
                    "image": ref(target),
                    "observation": observation,
                    "panels": panels,
                    "checkpoint_hashes": {k: v["sha256"] for k, v in checkpoints.items()},
                    "shared_display_contrast": contrast,
                    "shared_camera_RGB_anchor": anchor.ravel().tolist(),
                    "display_exposure": observation["display_exposure"],
                    "no_resize": True,
                }
            )

        emit(list(all_values), 1, "comparison")
        if observation["variant"]["name"] == "photo-faint":
            emit(list(all_values), 8, "contrast8-comparison")
        if observation["cohort"] == "organic384" and observation["source"]["id"] in (
            read(root / "organic-source-choice-v1.json")["sources"][0]["id"],
            read(root / "organic-source-choice-v1.json")["sources"][1]["id"],
        ):
            for method in ("V144", "V145"):
                emit(["Noisy", method, "Constructed GT"], 1, method + "-triplet")
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[row["cohort"], row["variant"], row["method"]].append(row)
    keys = [k for k, v in rows[0].items() if isinstance(v, float)]
    summary = [
        {
            "cohort": k[0],
            "variant": k[1],
            "method": k[2],
            "cases": len(v),
            "independent_source_images": len({r["source_id"] for r in v}),
            **{metric: float(np.mean([r[metric] for r in v])) for metric in keys},
        }
        for k, v in groups.items()
    ]
    save(
        out / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-photographic-supplement-report-awaiting-independent-audit-and-viewing",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "images": images,
            "actual_new_root_and_encoder_calls": 320,
            "new_noise_observations": 64,
            "metric_definition": "Camera-RGB error and DC/spatial decomposition; native160 linear-sRGB "
            "luma DCT16 annulus1/8<=frequency<1/3, no content selection. Ideal gain1; gain requires "
            "error/residual checks. Constructed targets are not exact physical scene GT. Per-CFA "
            "cases share16 source images; do not treat128 cases as128 independent photos.",
        },
    )
    print(out / "result-v1.json")
